subscriptions-management.name: Gestión de suscripción
subscriptions-management.description: Reactivar suscripción, ver historial de pagos
knownGaps: Dead surface (Rule 7): the flow's own description ("Reactivar suscripcion, ver historial de pagos") names capabilities with zero UI wiring. `reactivateSubscription()` and `fetchPaymentHistory()` (frontend/src/stores/subscriptions/index.js:143,182) call real, registered backend endpoints (subscriptions/reactivate/ -- note: NOT registered in urls.py at all; subscriptions/payments/ -- registered, urls.py:288) but are never invoked from any .vue file in the entire git history: `git log --all --oneline -S"reactivateSubscription" -- 'frontend/src/**/*.vue'` and the same for `fetchPaymentHistory` both return zero commits (only fff9a48/4578e6d touch the store). Subscriptions.vue (the /subscriptions page) is a static marketing catalog -- it never calls fetchCurrentSubscription or renders a current-plan/management indicator at all (`grep -in subscription frontend/src/views/subscriptions/Subscriptions.vue` returns only 2 unrelated navigation lines). The 7 tests currently tagged @flow:subscriptions-management (subscription-management.spec.js x4, subscription-management-flows.spec.js x3) all exercise catalog-browsing/checkout-navigation (duplicating subscriptions-view-plans) or one genuine PAID checkout completion (subscription-management-flows.spec.js:94, duplicating subscriptions-checkout-paid) -- none test reactivation or payment history.

subscriptions-cancel.name: Cancelar suscripción
subscriptions-cancel.description: Cancelar suscripción activa, plan vigente hasta fin de período, transición a plan gratuito
knownGaps: Dead surface (Rule 7), explicitly self-documented: subscription-cancel.spec.js:12-15 states verbatim "there is currently NO cancel-subscription UI in the frontend (no component calls subscriptions/cancel/)". Backend has TWO registered cancel endpoints (urls.py:286,290) and the store has `cancelSubscription()` (frontend/src/stores/subscriptions/index.js:125-134) but it is never called from any .vue file: `git log --all --oneline -S"cancelSubscription" -- 'frontend/src/**/*.vue'` returns zero commits (introduced only in the store by fff9a48/4578e6d, never referenced in a component since). The 2 tests tagged to this flow test a tangentially related but distinct thing: the cancel-anytime POLICY TEXT shown on the static plans page, and navigating to checkout for a plan change -- neither cancels anything.

subscriptions-update-payment.name: Actualizar método de pago
subscriptions-update-payment.description: Cambiar tarjeta de pago en suscripción activa vía tokenización Wompi
knownGaps: Dead surface (Rule 7), explicitly self-documented: subscription-update-payment.spec.js:11-14 states verbatim "there is currently NO standalone update-payment-method UI (no component calls subscriptions/update-payment-method/)". Backend endpoint is registered (urls.py:287, view at subscription.py:364) and the store wires `updatePaymentMethod(paymentSourceId)` (frontend/src/stores/subscriptions/index.js:162-172) to it, but it is never called from any .vue file: `git log --all --oneline -S"updatePaymentMethod" -- 'frontend/src/**/*.vue'` returns zero commits. What the spec file's own header names as "the real payment-method flow" -- tokenizing/replacing a card via Checkout.vue's own 'Cambiar' button -- only exists as a step INSIDE the initial paid-checkout purchase (Checkout.vue:402-469), duplicating subscriptions-checkout-paid's territory; it is not a way to change the card on an already-active subscription, which is what this flow's description promises.

notification-pagination.name: Paginación del centro de notificaciones
notification-pagination.description: Con más de una página, el usuario navega con Anterior/Siguiente y el indicador 'Página X de Y' se actualiza.

service-admin-delete.name: Eliminar servicio (admin)
service-admin-delete.description: Admin selecciona un servicio en /services_admin, pulsa 'Eliminar servicio', confirma en el SweetAlert y el servicio desaparece del catálogo (las solicitudes enviadas se conservan).

process-users-modal.name: Modal de participantes del proceso
process-users-modal.description: Desde el detalle del proceso, 'Ver usuarios' abre el modal de participantes con los clientes asociados (avatar/iniciales + nombre).

directory-navigate-to-process.name: Navegar del directorio a procesos
directory-navigate-to-process.description: Desde el modal de detalle de usuario del directorio, 'Ver proceso' navega al detalle del proceso y 'Ver todos en Procesos' al listado del usuario.

secop-list-error-retry.name: Reintentar carga del listado SECOP
secop-list-error-retry.description: Si la carga del listado SECOP falla, se muestra el estado de error con 'Reintentar'; el botón recarga y muestra la tabla.

sign-download-signatures-pdf.name: Descargar certificado de firmas (PDF)
sign-download-signatures-pdf.description: Sobre un documento completamente firmado, la acción 'Descargar Doc. Formalizado' del menú de la tarjeta descarga el PDF de firmas (generate-signatures-pdf).

org-corporate-dashboard-stats.name: KPIs del dashboard corporativo
org-corporate-dashboard-stats.description: El dashboard del cliente corporativo muestra los KPIs (organizaciones, miembros, invitaciones pendientes) desde organizations/stats/ y se actualizan tras invitar un miembro.
